summary: Iteration 5 tested Milestones G, C/H and the Marketplace. Backend: 93 tests, 91 pass. 15 are new in test_irgs_iter6.py, covering entities, notes, goals, development, act and pass-time replay, save preview/safety, and HEAD /api/s plus og:description '(snapshot)'. I also changed iter5 test_missing_span to expect 422 for the new required span. There are 2 real edge-case bugs: PATCH /notes accepts unknown entity_ids, and reactivating a goal bypasses the 8-active cap. Frontend: all requested flows work. Version labels on /login and in the nav dropdown show 'IRGS 3.3.E'. Marketplace has 3 slots. Chronicle has 4 tabs. People & places lists 4 Rome entities with mention counts, and the detail view shows attitude, the disposition change, the linked note and events. Notes: creating a document with a link shows it in the list with 'Linked: Henry V', it also appears in the entity detail, and delete removes it. Development: chart, intents and milestones render. A goal can be added, achieved, reactivated and abandoned, the status updates, milestone events are recorded, and the goal shows in Play gameplay-goals. Save preview dialog: turn/date/condition, last moments and impact are shown. Load creates a 'Before restoring “Auto-save”' save marked SAFETY, which is deletable while auto is not. Branch from the dialog goes to the new playthrough. Regression: an act on the branch committed with narration and an NPC follow-up. The store has 6 items. No page errors.

minor.issue: entity_ids are not filtered against known actors/locations, unlike POST. ['bogus_id'] is saved as-is. kind also can't be patched; that is acceptable, but the validation is inconsistent.
status='active' (reactivate) does not enforce the max of 8 active goals. Reproduce: add 8, abandon 1, add 1, reactivate the abandoned one, and you have 9 active (200).

A safety save is created even when nothing would be replaced (events_replaced == 0, e.g. loading the auto-save at the current position). This produces redundant safety saves, and their number is unbounded.

The frontend retries once on a network error, but if the first request is still running on the server (pid in _acting), the retry gets 409 'still being resolved' instead of the replay. The _acting check runs before the request_id replay lookup.
Goal changes write state but don't call _autosave, unlike act/pass-time, so the auto-save does not include goal events until the next turn.

integration_issues.issue: The review says the frontend retries once on a network error, but passTime() in Play.jsx sends request_id with no retry; only act() retries.

Saving or deleting a note does not invalidate the ['entity', pid, id] queries. Linked notes in an entity detail that was already loaded can be stale until refetch. They showed in the test because the Detail component remounts.

issues: The X axis is p.at/max, so lines start mid-chart when the first point is at turn 1 of 2. Normalise from the minimum 'at'. The legend's Stamina label is hard to read on dark themes.
No space before the '·' separator: '#1 11 August 1415·Player declaration'. Big-moment milestones use the generic title 'Player declaration'. DevelopmentPanel line 52 has a no-op ternary (dead code).

action_items: Filter NotePatch.entity_ids against state actors/locations (same as create_note)
Enforce the 8-active cap when a goal is reactivated (status='active')
Skip or limit safety saves when events_replaced == 0, and consider capping the number of safety saves
In /act and /pass-time, check the request_id replay before the _acting 409 (or return a 'pending' result) so the frontend retry is useful
Add the retry-once to passTime() in Play.jsx if that is intended
Invalidate the 'entity' queries after a note is created or deleted; fix the development chart X scaling and the milestone separator spacing
critical_code_review_comments: load_save always inserts a safety save, which grows without bound
The act retry race with _acting is described above
